title: 第240章 恐怖的诅咒敖琉璃泪目我的父皇呢第241章 获得一族底蕴重塑肉身完美之法
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 开始将自己收集到关于镇龙殿的信息输入七宗诅咒书中。
他不知道镇龙殿成员的真名。
但是模糊信息还是知道不少的。
毕竟他搜魂了几个镇龙殿的猎龙使。
李长生将模糊信息补充上去之后，就开始在七宗诅咒书中写入诅咒信息。
“诅咒镇龙殿殿主及核心高层，在接下来的一天内，气运跌至谷底，霉运缠身，陷入极大的麻烦中。”
第一次诅咒只不过是尝试而已。
李长生也没想着一次就能诅咒成功。
主要是想体验一下诅咒书的新功能。
随后七宗诅咒书中便冒出刺眼的黑色光芒，一行模糊的字体逐一呈现。
【模糊诅咒发动。】
【正在进行因果律判定……】
【目标：镇龙殿殿主及核心高层。】
【关联信息：猎龙使残余气息、组织名称、大致外貌特征。】
【判定中……】
【判定失败。】
【剩余发动次数：23。】
李长生看了整个判定的过程。
感觉融合碎片版的诅咒书还是比较好用的。
至少能够让自己知道诅咒是否成功了。
不过。
这次诅咒失败。
乃是意料之中的事情。
一次失败。
还有第二次。
第二次失败，还有第三次。
咱们要有愚公移山的精神。
李长生心念间又开始了第二次诅咒。
“诅咒镇龙殿成员，遭遇人生中一大不测。。”
【模糊诅咒发动。】
【判定中……】
【判定失败。】
【剩余发动次数：13。】
李长生很无奈。
两次诅咒失败。
这让他清楚地知道了，即便是升级后的4种诅咒书，诅咒成功的概率依旧是比较低的。
今天自己剩下最后一次诅咒机会了。
我应该将之赏给谁呢？
李长生想了想。
顿时决定将最后一次诅咒的机会送给玄武。
玄武一直在等自己去开启东海龙宫。
content_en:
He began to enter the information he collected about Zhenlong Palace into the Seven Curses Book.
He did not know the real names of the members of Zhenlong Palace.
But we still know a lot of vague information.
After all, he searched the souls of several Dragon Hunters from the Dragon Suppression Hall.
After Li Changsheng added the vague information, he began to write the curse information in the Seven Curses Book.
"Curse the Lord of Zhenlong Palace and the core executives. In the next day, their luck will hit rock bottom, they will be riddled with bad luck, and they will fall into great trouble."
The first curse was nothing more than an attempt.
Li Changsheng didn't expect that the curse could be successful in one go.
Mainly I want to experience the new features of the Book of Curses.
Then a dazzling black light emerged from the book of seven curses, and a line of blurry fonts appeared one by one.
[The vague curse is activated. 】
[Determining the law of causality in progress...]
[Target: Zhenlong Hall’s master and core senior officials. 】
[Related information: The remaining aura of the dragon hunter, the name of the organization, and general appearance characteristics. 】
[Determining...]
[Judgment failed. 】
[Remaining number of activations: 23. 】
Li Changsheng watched the entire judgment process.
I feel that the fused fragment version of the Book of Curses is relatively easy to use.
At least he could let himself know whether the curse was successful or not.
but.
This time the curse failed.
This is to be expected.
A failure.
There is a second time.
The second time it failed, there was a third time.
We must have the spirit of Foolish Old Man who can move mountains.
Li Changsheng started a second curse in his mind.
"The members of the Dragon-Suppressing Palace were cursed to encounter a major accident in their lives."
[Ding. 】
[The vague curse is activated. 】
[Determining...]
[Judgment failed. 】
[Remaining number of activations: 13. 】
Li Changsheng was helpless.
Two curses failed.
This made it clear to him that even with the four upgraded curse books, the probability of the curse succeeding was still relatively low.
Today I have the last chance to curse.
Who should I give it to?
Li Changsheng thought for a while.
He immediately decided to give Xuanwu his last chance to curse.
Xuanwu has been waiting for him to open the East China Sea Dragon Palace.
